section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section interprets the findings of a single study, focusing on the relationships between personality traits (Neuroticism and Extraversion) and body image (drive for muscularity and body appreciation) in a sample of men. It highlights that Neuroticism was positively associated with drive for muscularity and negatively with body appreciation, while Extraversion was positively associated with body appreciation. The section also discusses practical implications for mental health practitioners and suggests future research directions, such as examining lower-order Big Five facets and indirect pathways. Table 2 presents the standardized and unstandardized regression coefficients for these relationships.
